olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: The product of two of the four roots of $x^4-18x^3+kx^2+200x-1984=0$ is $-32$. Find $k$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1984

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: (i) For which $n$ is there a finite set $S_n$ of $n$ distinct positive integers whose geometric mean of any subset is an integer? (ii) Is there an infinite such set?
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1984

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $P,A,B,C,D$ are distinct points with $\angle APB=\angle BPC=\angle CPD=\angle DPA=\theta$ (acute). Find the greatest and least values of $\angle APC+\angle BPD$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1984

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: A competition had 28 problems (Part I and Part II). Each contestant solved 7 problems. For each pair of problems, exactly two contestants solved both. Prove some contestant solved no problems or at least four problems in Part I.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1984
